_meta.title: Privilege Escalation & Post-Exploitation
_meta.description: From foothold to system/root: kernel LPE, token manipulation, service misconfigurations, and the living-off-the-land binaries that make both operating systems into their own exploit kits.

techniques.name: Kernel / OS-Level LPE Exploits
techniques.summary: Public kernel exploits (PrintNightmare-class, Dirty Pipe, catch-all driver primitives) turn user-land footholds into SYSTEM/root. The reliability game is patch-level fingerprinting: knowing which kernel build is vulnerable before firing anything.

detection.description: Kernel driver load events from user paths (Sysmon EID 6), suspicious named-pipe activity around spooler/services, process token changes, EDR alerts on known exploit tooling signatures (Printspoofer, etc.).
mitigations: Unprivileged driver load blocking, Microsoft Vulnerable Driver Blocklist
Restrict Spooler service on non-print servers
Credential Guard and VBS raise the floor

techniques.name: Service Misconfiguration Escalation (Path, ACL, Unquoted)
techniques.summary: Services running as SYSTEM with: unquoted binary paths (C:\Program Files\Vendor\svc.exe hijacks to C:\Program.exe), weak ACLs on the service or its binary (ChangeServiceConfig via accesschk), or world-writable directories in the DLL search order. Enumeration is cheap; the misconfigurations are endemic.

detection.description: Service binary path writes by non-SYSTEM principals (Sysmon EID 11 on service directories), service reconfiguration events (EID 7045/4697), accesschk/BeClass-class enumeration tooling process starts.
mitigations: Quote every service binary path (deployment lint rule)
icacls audit on service directories; ACL should be SYSTEM/Administrators write-only
Monitor EID 7045 for new service installs by non-admins

techniques.name: Token Impersonation & UAC Bypass
techniques.summary: Steal or impersonate primary/impersonation tokens of privileged processes (SeImpersonate abuse via Potato-class token coercion, or named-pipe token capture), and abuse auto-elevate binaries (fodhelper, computerdefaults) to skip the UAC prompt when in a high-integrity-eligible context.

detection.description: Named-pipe creation by unusual processes, token privilege assignments (EID 4673), auto-elevate binary spawning with command-line arguments pointing to temp (Sysmon EID 1 lineage: fodhelper.exe -> cmd.exe), potato-class tool signatures.
mitigations: Remove SeImpersonatePrivilege from service accounts that don't need it
UAC set to 'Always Notify' (blocks most auto-elevate abuse)
EDR lineage rules on auto-elevate binaries
Credential Guard, and patch Potato-class vectors (they ride legitimate DCOM/RPC behaviors)

techniques.name: DLL Search Order Hijacking & Side-Loading
techniques.summary: Plant a malicious DLL in a directory searched before the legitimate one, or proxy a legitimate signed binary's imports (side-load via version.dll, winmm.dll in a known-vulnerable signed app). The signed-binary variant doubles as defense evasion, which is why it survives so long in the wild.

detection.description: Sysmon EID 7 (image load) - DLLs loaded from user-writable paths, unsigned DLLs loaded by signed processes, new DLL writes into application directories (EID 11); known-abused binaries appearing in odd contexts.
mitigations: Set DLL directory to absolute, use SetDefaultDllDirectories where possible
Code-signing requirement on loaded modules for high-value apps
EDR image-load rules for user-path loads by privileged processes

techniques.name: Linux SUID / Capabilities / Cron / PATH Abuse
techniques.summary: The classic Unix ladder: SUID binaries with shell escapes (GTFOBins is literally a lookup table), file capabilities (cap_setuid on an interpreter), world-writable cron scripts, PATH shadowing in root-invoked scripts, and sudo rules with NOPASSWD on interpreters or wildcards.

detection.description: auditd execve with euid=0 from unexpected binaries; new SUID binaries appearing (file integrity monitoring, e.g. AIDE); cron edits by non-root; sudo invocations with unusual arguments (sudoers EID-logging via sudoers audit plugin).
mitigations: File integrity monitoring for SUID drift; scheduled SUID inventory diffs
sudo: NOEXEC/arg restriction, no NOPASSWD on interpreters, secure_path enforced
Cron scripts: absolute paths, root-owned directories, chattr on stable scripts
Remove file capabilities not required at runtime (getcap -r / sweep)
